jobs.title: Senior Engineer, Data and AI
jobs.snippet: About the role: Slalom is hiring a Senior Engineer, Data and AI based in Sydney, Canberra or Melbourne. Engineers work in teams with little supervision on AWS, Azure, and Google Cloud, and they help build client data platforms under a Solution Architect's direction. The role also includes taking part in design sessions and breaking complex development work into manageable tasks. Requirements include 4+ years of data engineering experience, with SQL and Python as main languages. Preferred skills include AWS (with Azure and GCP valued), cloud warehouses and lakehouses such as Redshift, Snowflake, or Databricks, and ETL/ELT tools such as AWS Glue or Azure Data Factory. AI/ML tooling such as SageMaker or MLflow is listed as beneficial but not essential.

jobs.snippet: 北京腾云天下科技招聘算法工程师/大模型研究员，岗位职责包括大模型预训练、后训练及推理优化算法研发，参与模型能力评估与前沿技术跟踪。任职要求：硕士及以上学历，计算机、数学、统计等相关专业，熟悉Python和PyTorch，具备Transformer等大模型架构基础，有大模型训练或推理优化经验者优先。工作地点：北京。
